args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in 2.9.4 (2.x line).

CI: passed (run ci-0001).
